plugins.name: chanmeng-linkedin-post
plugins.description: Claude Code skill: turns an idea into on-brand LinkedIn and X posts (story, idea, take, recap), gives every post a visual — Mermaid, HTML-rendered, or a hand-drawn brand-monkey illustration — and hands back one markdown file. Never opens LinkedIn or X; you post.
